caption: The circuit lane waits 3 s for setup, sends for 12 s, then spends 5 s on teardown. The packet lane starts at once and sends four 3 s packets; it has no setup phase.

spec.aria: Two timelines: the circuit line pays a setup phase before any data moves and a teardown after, while the packet line starts sending packets at once and pays only per-packet store-and-forward.
